bugs.location: DLight GEMV rule queries a target attribute that the auto-detected CUDA target lacks
bugs.root_cause: DLight GEMV schedule rule crashes with KeyError on auto-detected CUDA
ONNX Softmax/LogSoftmax/Hardmax frontend ignores opset <13 semantics
ONNX ScatterElements ignores `reduction` attribute, silently produces wrong results
ONNX Gather with negative indices reads out-of-bounds memory (garbage values)
CumSum ignores axis parameter, always reduces along axis 0
scatter_elements / scatter_nd fail to compile for CUDA target

bugs.location: CodeGenVM intrinsic for isnan / isinf / isfinite

bugs.root_cause: ONNX TopK operator crashes during `from_onnx()` — K tensor scalar extraction failure
`ReorderPermuteDimsAfterConcat` pass crashes with negative concat axis — missing index normalization
`DataflowUseInplaceCalls` corrupts concat input via incorrect liveness analysis — in-place buffer reuse on still-live value

bugs.location: NaN semantics of maximum / minimum / relu / clip
bugs.root_cause: `maximum`/`minimum`/`relu`/`clip` do not propagate NaN (IEEE 754 violation) — LLVM `maxss`/`maxps` semantics

bugs.location: NaN semantics of Relu / Sign / ReduceMax / ReduceMin
bugs.root_cause: Relax/ONNX `Relu`, `Sign` convert NaN to 0 instead of preserving it; `ReduceMax`/`ReduceMin` exhibit position-dependent NaN behavior — improper `fmax`/`fmin` semantics + comparison chains failing to propagate NaN

`LegalizeOps` lowering of `relax.nn.batch_norm` recomputes mean/variance from input data instead of using supplied `running_mean`/`running_var`, producing training-mode behavior under inference — repro shows max error ~60 vs ground truth
Relax/ONNX `CumSum` with `exclusive=1` hits a bare `AssertionError` in `CumSum._impl_v14` — `topi.cumsum`/`relax.op.cumsum` only implement the inclusive variant

Relax/ONNX `GridSample._impl_v16` unconditionally permutes grid from `[N,H,W,2]` to `[N,2,H,W]` and dispatches to 2D `image.grid_sample`, crashing on 5D volumetric inputs (`PermuteDims` expects 4 axes but tensor ndim=5)

Relax/ONNX `LayerNormalization` without optional bias synthesizes a zero bias of shape `data.shape[1]` instead of `gamma_shape`, causing dimension mismatch in `relax.nn.layer_norm` (breaks PyTorch transformers exported with `LayerNorm(bias=False)`)

`relax.op.nn.attention` fails to legalize when batch dim is a symbolic `tir.Var` — `_te_attention` builds two `Mul(B, num_head)` exprs, and `topi.nn.batch_matmul` compares them with Python `==` which returns a deferred `PrimExpr` instead of `True`, tripping the batch-dim assertion

oatest_missed_bugs.source: Shen et al., Optimization-Aware Test Generation for Deep Learning Compilers, ICSE 2026, arXiv:2511.18918, Section 4.3 (RQ2)
oatest_missed_bugs.quote: Among those bugs detected by baselines, only three are not detected by OATest, all of which occur in the model loading stage rather than compiler optimizations.
